ingredients_text: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida) 62%, Whole Wheat Flour (Atta) 24%, Edible Vegetable Oil (Refined Palm Oil), Sugar, Invert Sugar Syrup, Raising Agents [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii)], Emulsifier [INS 471, INS 322], Iodised Salt, Artificial Flavouring (Milk, Vanilla).
ground_truth_violations: Misleading '100% Whole Wheat Atta' claim: Refined wheat flour (Maida) makes up 62% of the flour component, while Atta is only 24% (violates FSSAI Advertising and Claims Regulation 2020 Section 7).
Unhealthy fat profile: Refined Palm Oil is the primary fat source with > 50% saturated palmitic acid.
Hidden sugar splitting: Uses Sugar (22g) alongside Invert Sugar Syrup to keep table sugar lower in weight.

ingredients_text: Malt Extract 42%, Cereal Extract, Milk Solids, Maltodextrin 26%, Cocoa Solids 8%, Non-Sugar Artificial Sweetener [INS 955 (Sucralose)], Emulsifier [INS 322], Acidity Regulators [INS 501(i), INS 500(ii)], Vitamin Mineral Premix, Natural Identical Vanilla Flavour.
ground_truth_violations: Deceptive 'No Added Sugar' claim: Contains 26% Maltodextrin (Glycemic Index = 110-185, spikes blood glucose faster than table sugar) to substitute sucrose (violates FSSAI Schedule II Section 4).
Violation of WHO 2023 Non-Sugar Sweetener (NSS) Guidelines: Contains Sucralose (INS 955) in a children's daily growth beverage.
Ultra-processed formulation: High carbohydrate load (>78%) disguised as healthy malt.

ingredients_text: Water, Mixed Fruit Reconstituted Juice Concentrate 12% (Apple Juice 7%, Pomegranate Juice 3%, Strawberry Puree 2%), Sugar, Acidity Regulator [INS 330], Antioxidant [INS 300 (Ascorbic Acid / Vitamin C)], Class II Preservative [INS 211 (Sodium Benzoate)], Synthetic Food Color [INS 122 (Carmoisine)], Nature Identical Mixed Berry Flavouring Substances.
ground_truth_violations: Blatant '100% Natural' and 'No Preservatives' violation: Contains Class II synthetic preservative Sodium Benzoate (INS 211) and synthetic dye Carmoisine (INS 122) (FSSAI Regulation 4 violation).
Severe chemical hazard: Combination of Sodium Benzoate (INS 211) and Vitamin C (INS 300) in an acidic drink can react to synthesize Benzene (known human carcinogen).
Diluted juice: 88% of the product is filtered water and refined sugar, with only 12% reconstituted juice concentrate.

ingredients_text: Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Soya Protein Crisps) 32%, Prebiotic Dietary Fibre (Polydextrose), Fractionated Palm Kernel Oil, Humectant [INS 422], Artificial Sweeteners [INS 955 (Sucralose), INS 950 (Acesulfame K)], Synthetic Food Colour [INS 150d (Caramel IV)], Emulsifiers [INS 322, INS 471], Natural and Artificial Flavours.
ground_truth_violations: Contains Caramel Color IV (INS 150d): Contains trace 4-methylimidazole (4-MEI), listed as potentially carcinogenic.
High Saturated Fat: Relies on fractionated palm kernel oil (11.2g saturated fat per 100g) while claiming 'Clean Nutrition'.
Artificial Sweetener Cocktail: Blends Sucralose (INS 955) and Acesulfame K (INS 950) with high sugar alcohol load (polyols 18g) which causes severe gastric distress.
